As we already aligned, this charger's HMI was fully black today and not responsive. After trying to replace the DP cable, still didn't work.
We measured 24V at the input so it seems like the PCB has an issue that we cannot find due to warranty claims.
Please replace the HMI.
Thank you!
BR,
Francisco
